'''2014 Worlds Day 3 Angelo Consoli DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Angelo Consoli]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 3).

2013 Players Committee sheet. Ditto marks expanded. (V) follows the sheet checkbox. Lines 52–53 are written Cyborg Commander and line 54 IG-Bodyguard Droid (no matching printed titles; left as written).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-D-astunningmove-pre.gif|label=A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
